notes.title: Steam Awards 2018
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear Puzzlers![/b]

Currently the nomination period for the Steam Awards 2018 is in full progress!

Today is the last day for voting and we would of course love to participate!
If you like Crazy Machines VR and you would like to support us then please had over to:

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwardNominations]https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwardNominations[/url][/i]

The “Most fun with a machine” would be a perfect category for us! *wink*

[b]A big thank you to all the supports in advantage! We are really grateful to you![/b]



And now back to work! We want to put all your helpful feedback into a patch as soon as possible!

notes.title: The interactive sandbox rooms
notes.content:
[b]Hello there dear puzzlers![/b]

There has been some confusion regarding the interactive sandbox rooms. 
We realized that the name was a bit misleading after watching/ reading some reviews.
As some of you are familiar with the Crazy Machines 3 Editor, some of you thought the sandbox rooms would be the same for VR. So a mode where you can build your own contraptions.

But they are actually interactive toy rooms for you to relax or go a bit crazy in between all the puzzle solving.
So to be the description more transparent and easier to understand, we changed the name to "[b]Toy room/s[/b]".

We are sorry for the little confusion and are very grateful for all your feedback until now!

We are working hard to fix the other small things that popped up!

[b]You Crazy Machines VR Dev Team 😊[/b]

notes.title: And we are done!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33751898/87dfaea7157a74bc5250852fbdf00f8f83bf29ab.png[/img]
Finally! After over a year of working and tinkering we are done! Everything in set and ready to go and we are happy to present to you “CRAZY MACHINES VR”!

Put on your headsets and grab your controllers! It is time to play a certain VR video game!

We prepared some cool new things for you and we really hope you will like them!

Have a lot of fun playing CRAZY MACHINES VR!
